title: Greater Niagara
summary: A non-technical profile of existing companies, their activities, and investment across the Niagara area in New York and Ontario.
why: The industrial system here crosses that border. This subsite brings the research to life for a general reader: who the companies are, what they do, and the investment around them.
span: Greater Niagara is the name of this subsite. Niagara Region, the Ontario upper-tier municipality, is one place inside the area, not the name of the whole.
focus: Companies, their activities, and investment are the subject. Agriculture and food is one theme, not the lead subject. The record of how evidence was handled sits on one Methods page.
